description: United Republic of Tanzania - Earthquake on Jan 20 2026 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. ADAM ID: sm\ us7000rqva Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jan 20 2026 10km NE of Somanga. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -8.3278 longitude 39.3491. It impacted 85522 people within 50km. Coverage: Tanzania. The portal files it under the publisher WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. Its tags are affected population, earthquake-tsunami, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-05-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
